suggestions.title: Check whether you still need the FitWell Flex 12 membership
suggestions.body: Your FitWell gym membership costs €29.90 a month (€358.80 a year) and can be cancelled with one month's notice at any time. Worth a quick check if you're still using it.

suggestions.title: Share your new enrolment certificate with employer and gym
suggestions.body: Both your working-student contract and your gym's student rate require proof of enrolment each semester. Your winter 2026/27 certificate is already on file — forward it to keep your status current.
